repository.name: HA-Energy-Price-Engine
repository.description: A modular Home Assistant integration that automatically retrieves, calculates and stores complete electricity prices, including spot prices, grid tariffs, supplier fees, taxes and VAT. Provides persistent 15-minute price data for EV charging, heating, battery storage and smart energy automation.

release.name: v0.1.0-beta.6 — simple marginal charging prices
release.body:
Beta.6 simplifies native setup to **official Nord Pool → confirmed grid tariff → actual supplier markup**. Enter fractional **øre/kWh** with a point or comma and confirm VAT. No ordinary product/monthly/date/heating decisions. Each accepted page saves; Configure resumes after closing. Review needs no final save.

**Prerelease for development Home Assistant acceptance.** Actual agreements, real providers and hardware still require owner checks. Source **f5a18152748205906bfd5e7ae7a72b592943e742**; immutable **v0.1.0-beta.6**. [Draft PR #14](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/pull/14) stays unmerged. Main and all prior releases preserved.

## HACS install/update

1. Back up development HA. Add `https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine` as a HACS custom **Integration** repository if needed.
2. Persist **Show beta versions**, refresh information, select **v0.1.0-beta.6**, download and restart HA. Reload browser/app. Device info must show **0.1.0-beta.6**.
3. Existing users: Configure the existing site. New users: install/configure official Home Assistant Nord Pool first, then Add integration → Energy Price Engine. No simultaneous legacy broker is needed.
4. Confirm the actual area and grid class; automatic Radius C requires an actual Radius C contract. Enter the actual supplier markup/VAT. National public charges are automatic within documented verified periods. Never substitute a public offer or another site's agreement for your contract.
5. Review raw/final coverage. Final prices opens current/future canonical component diagnostics and the optional supplied-quarter-kWh cost estimate. Check prices forces verification. Advanced retains dated overrides, source contracts, optional offers/heating/display and storage/site tools.

[Illustrated setup / 26 screenshots](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.6/docs/WIZARD_GUIDE.md) · [HACS procedure](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.6/docs/HACS_DISTRIBUTION.md) · [Acceptance checklist](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.6/docs/BETA_ACCEPTANCE.md) · [Native simulation receipt](https://github.com/NicolaiTandrup/HA-Energy-Price-Engine/blob/v0.1.0-beta.6/docs/receipts/v0.1.0-beta.6-simulation.json)

## Changes and safety

- Decimal-safe **0.25/0.50/0.75/3.125** markup, localized comma, exact saved decimal values and explicit VAT basis. Fixed monthly fees never enter marginal prices or session costs.
- Named server-resolved menus, complete EN/en-GB/DA forms, compatibility with cached draft_status descriptions, actionable source/timezone errors. Official mode hides irrelevant entity fields; alternate mode requires a complete source contract. Interrupted beta.5 agreements resume the new simple form.
- Current/future component amounts/source/period/status read **canonical stored components**. Every quarter uses its own Radius time band and dated revision; VAT is applied once. Raw prices remain independent. Missing/stale rates never become zero.
- An optional read-only calculator uses **supplied** planned/measured kWh for consecutive quarters and API v1 verified prices. It invents no energy or plan, excludes fixed fees and is explicitly an estimate, never settled accounting. Future energy must be planned. CM retains session/planning/control ownership.
- Explicitly approved visual estimates remain **Provisional**, separate from verified history/revisions/API READY and unavailable for authoritative session costs. Retained stale rows never override a fresh approved visualization estimate.
- Existing beta.1–.5 IDs, names, source references, mappings, dated rules, overrides, entities, SQLite rows/revisions and canonical **DKK/kWh read-only API v1** are preserved. Tested actual beta.5 upgrade:10 configs/1,000 original rows unchanged; native restart14 configs/1,106 rows unchanged. Safe confirmed selected-site deletion retains other sites/recorder; HACS uninstall retains data.
- New confirmed values begin **next complete quarter**, until changed. No settled/unknown-past backfill; explicit future rules survive. Initial-day full-day reads can be INCOMPLETE while complete active ranges are READY. Tomorrow depends on source publication.
- Required local refreshes **13:05,13:20,13:40,23:59,00:01** preserved. Negative spot prices,92/96/100-quarter DST, season/midnight TOU and fail-closed recovery covered. Issue#10 graphs and whole-household invoice reconstruction remain separate.

## Validation and integrity

**277 producer tests/core** on HA **2026.10.3 / current 2026.10.4**,88% coverage,zero skips;two unchanged upstream HACS deprecation warnings. Four unchanged consumer suites153/176/227/228 per core plus two coupled runtime cases/reference/core. Official hassfest/HACS/translations, all15 exact-source push/PR/tag checks and clean deterministic both-layout native installs pass before publication. Fresh independent postpublication jobs on both cores verify public metadata/assets/source and actual pinned HACS2.0.5/upstream install/update/reinstall and semantic beta5→6 selection; permanent receipt is recorded only after both succeed.

Native actual HA2026.10.4/frontend20260930.5 EN/en-GB/DA desktop/mobile simulation uses recorded/synthetic provider boundaries, not owner acceptance. Peak147.946625ore then normal68.3155ore with fictional0.5ore exVAT markup; supplied1.25/2kWh costs3.2156428125DKK. All current/future amounts and source identities are inspectable. Normal/fall/spring Radius96/100/92 rows use their own TOU.

ZIP SHA256:
- `ha_energy_price_engine.zip`: `909c75c26649e91f6dfb4d908f36db8dd65cd83c4a72153be9beef6d890630de`
- `ha_energy_price_engine-manual.zip`: `d0b3672ddfe0a984adae40a75e6f8fc66a15c371263d93cd783409812b83e2ea`

## Limits

Automatic DSO starts with Radius C; other products/future periods need verified rules. National values are bounded dated baselines, not live legislation discovery. Never guess heating eligibility/private contracts. Accepted pages persist; closing cannot save unsubmitted typing and native forms have no dedicated per-page Back. Entity names follow HA registry/system language; forms follow user language. HACS external catalog icon may fall back. Original SQLite touched-row performance retained:cloud35,136 rows/18.24MB,96-row append.0288s/reload1.066s/indexedlookup5.29µs. **Cloud timings do not establish Raspberry Pi performance.** History remains in RAM for API v1; measure hardware capacity/recovery yourself.

No production HA, Node-RED, vehicles, chargers or CM controls touched. No main merge/stable release. Stop after beta.6 publication, independent verification and permanent handoff.
